// Small pure functions used by the e2e scenarios.

/** Sum of xs; 0 for an empty array. */
export function sum(xs: number[]): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (const x of xs) {
    total += x;
  }
  return total;
}

/** xs without repeated values, keeping the first occurrence of each. */
export function dedupe(xs: number[]): number[] {
  const seen = new Set<number>();
  const out: number[] = [];
  for (const x of xs) {
    if (seen.has(x)) {
      continue;
    }
    seen.add(x);
    out.push(x);
  }
  return out;
}

/** Clamp x into the inclusive range [lo, hi]. */
export function clamp(x: number, lo: number, hi: number): number {
  if (x < lo) {
    return lo;
  }
  if (x > hi) {
    return hi;
  }
  return x;
}
